services.title: Emergency Boiler Repairs

services.title: Boiler Installations

services.title: Landlord Gas Safety Checks

about_pullquote: I answer the phone myself because every customer deserves someone who listens, not a call centre.
about_para_1: JC Gas Plumbing & Heating Limited has been serving Stoke-on-Trent homes and businesses for over a decade. Founded on the principle that heating emergencies don't wait for office hours, we've built a reputation for fast, honest work at fair prices. Gas Safe registered and fully insured, every job comes with a completion certificate and our commitment to get it right first time.
about_para_2: What keeps customers coming back is simple: we turn up on time, we explain what's wrong without the jargon, and we don't overcharge. Whether it's a midnight boiler failure or a planned winter service, you'll speak to the same experienced engineer who diagnosed the fault. No cowboys, no surprises—just a straightforward fix you can trust.
reviews_heading: What Stoke-on-Trent Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Boiler packed in on a Sunday morning in January. Rang JC and he was at my door by 11am. Turned out to be the pump—he had it running again within an hour. Brilliant service, very fair price. Top bloke.
reviews.author: Paul D.

reviews.text: Had the annual service and he spotted a small crack developing in the heat exchanger. Fixed it before it became a big job. This is the kind of attention you want. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Margaret H.

reviews.text: Needed a new boiler installed before the cold weather kicked in. JC organised everything—quoted on the phone, fitted it mid-week, and left me with all the paperwork. No stress, no mess. Will use again next time I need a plumber.
reviews.author: David T.
